subject: Regional Offer Tiers, Metering Windows & Co-sell Preconditions
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@aws-partners.amazon.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@cloudprocure.io>
Date: 2027-07-11T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + quick ask on how you want to frame regional offers

Sofia — great connecting earlier. AWS GTM wants a short summary of how Redwood will present regional offers across AWS, Azure, GCP for the Acme PoC. A few questions from our side that determine co-sell eligibility:

- Which offer tiers will be available in the US vs EU at launch?
- Do you plan a metered trial SKU (hourly tokens) or a time-limited free trial?
- Any restrictions on egress / cross-region data flow we should highlight for customers?

If you can send a 1-pager we can attach to our co-sell intake. Happy to jump on a 20m call to align.

—Alex
AWS Partner Manager
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@aws-partners.amazon.com>, Nadia Khan <nadia@acmeai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + quick ask on how you want to frame regional offers

Thanks Alex — attaching a quick starter doc and some notes below. Nadia, Samir, copying Karthik and Lauren to confirm product & GTM constraints. Key points:  

1) Offer tiers (initial):
   - Entry (metered): limited token throughput, US-only launch. Metered by token-seconds; integrates with AWS Marketplace metering (we will emit usage records via AMR).
   - Standard (committed): regional availability US + EU; monthly commit; supports cross-region read-only logs.
   - Enterprise (reserved): global availability including APAC; dedicated instances (Redwood Dedicated) and enhanced SLA.

2) Metered trial approach:
   - For AWS: use metered SKU for 30-day trial (token cap rather than time cap) so partners can see true token-based cost.
   - For Azure & GCP: use time-limited free trial credit (to align with respective marketplace metering differences).

3) Egress / data residency:
   - By default, inference compute and logs stay in-region. Cross-region egress allowed only for audit endpoints with explicit consent.
   - For Acme (regulated), we recommend US-only tenancy for initial PoC.

Open questions for legal/procurement: are we comfortable with AWS AMR latency for near-realtime metering? Karthik — can you confirm engineering on AMR hooks?

Sofia
Director, Partner GTM
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@aws-partners.amazon.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-11T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + quick ask on how you want to frame regional offers

Quick tech check:
- AMR hooks: engineering has a tested pipeline to emit per-customer metering records to AWS Marketplace; latency is ~5–10s for batches so metered UI will be near realtime for dashboards but not per-token streaming. That fits entry SKU expectations.
- Azure metering uses marketplace metering API (different shape) — we'll surface a credit-based trial token cap mapping (we already have the mapping table in the attached spreadsheet).
- GCP: metering integration is manual for now; recommend time-limited credit for launch.

Also, note a packaging constraint: Dedicated reserved instances require a minimum commitment for APAC regions (vendor-allocated GPUs). That affects when Enterprise SKU can include APAC.

Karthik
Senior Product Engineer, Serving Runtime
From: Nadia Khan <nadia@acmeai.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-11T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + quick ask on how you want to frame regional offers

Appreciate the clarity — the metered trial sounds ideal. A couple asks from Acme side before we commit to the PoC:  

- Can we lock token caps at the start of the trial and get an estimate of burn per 1,000 prompt/response cycles? (helps budget planning)
- If we need to move the PoC from US to EU mid-run, what is the expected downtime or failover plan?

If it's easier, we can do a short call tomorrow to go through the spreadsheet.

—Nadia
VP Product, Acme AI
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Nadia Khan <nadia@acmeai.com>, Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@aws-partners.amazon.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-12T09:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + quick ask on how you want to frame regional offers

Nadia — good questions. Short answers:
- Token burn: rough baseline in the spreadsheet (tab: estimators). For the most common prompt pattern (single-turn Q&A, ~120 tokens in + 140 tokens out) expect ~260 tokens per cycle; multiply by your projected cycles. We will provide a calibrated estimate before PoC start.
- Mid-run region move: we support in-place migration with a brief maintenance window (typically 3–7 minutes for session replay/KV cache warmup) if both sides accept temporary session reset. For strict zero-downtime, we need cross-region KV pre-warm which adds ~2–4 hours to preparatory ops; recommend discussing only if the PoC requires uninterrupted sessions.

Next steps:
1) Karthik to confirm AMR metering timeline and add notes to the spreadsheet (by EOD).
2) Lauren to prepare a 1-page co-sell summary for AWS intake (one-pager + attachments).
3) Nadia — if you’re open, book a 30m slot and we’ll walk through the estimator. I’m proposing Tue 7/13 10:00a PT.

Sofia
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Nadia Khan <nadia@acmeai.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@aws-partners.amazon.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-12T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + quick ask on how you want to frame regional offers

Thanks all — attaching the one-pager we’ll submit to AWS AMR intake. Highlights included: entry metered SKU (US-only), standard committed (US+EU), and enterprise reserved (global pending APAC capacity). Also call out co-sell preconditions: joint case study plan, a short technical readiness checklist, and a single-point contact for procurement.

Attachments: co-sell-checklist-AWS.pdf (quick checklist), redwood-offer-tranches-v1.xlsx (pricing & region matrix), metering-specs-gcp-azure.docx (integration notes).

Nadia — I booked Tue 7/13 10:00a PT — invite sent. If that time doesn't work, let me know and we can move.

—Lauren
Partner Sales
Redwood Inference
